comments.author: @lifeonearth68
comments.text: It's crazy how much work goes into keeping parts of the Netherlands dry. Do people living there ever worry about flooding, or is it just something they've learned to live with?

comments.author: @travelintolifeus
comments.text: Living in the Netherlands must be quite an experience, especially growing up surrounded by cycling culture, historic windmills, and beautifully managed waterways. I love how practical and connected everyday life seems to be. There's something inspiring about a country that has built so much around working together with nature.
